RESTAURANT.definition: The restaurant as a whole, covering overall opinions, the general price or value of the place, and miscellaneous aspects (e.g., reservations, menu variety, portions policy) not attributable to another entity.

FOOD.definition: The food served, whether a specific dish or food in general, including its taste, quality, style/options, portion size and price.

DRINKS.definition: The beverages served (wine, beer, cocktails, coffee, soft drinks), including their quality, style/options and price.

SERVICE.definition: The service and staff, including attentiveness, friendliness, speed, professionalism of waiters, hosts and other personnel, and the handling of orders and reservations.

AMBIENCE.definition: The atmosphere and surroundings of the restaurant, such as decor, music, noise level, lighting, seating, space and cleanliness of the setting.

LOCATION.definition: The location of the restaurant, including its neighborhood, convenience of access, and the view or surroundings outside it.
